stem.text: A cathedral in New Zealand has been constructed from cardboard. Cardboard contains polymer molecules. Part of one such polymer molecule is shown below.

stem.alt: Part of a polymer chain drawn in square brackets, made of linked six-membered ring units each bearing CH2OH and OH groups (cellulose-type polymer), with bonds through ring oxygen atoms.

stem.text: Which statements about this polymer are correct?

items: The polymer molecules can form hydrogen bonds with each other.
The polymer can form intermolecular forces with water molecules.
The polymer will not burn easily because it is a secondary alcohol.
